channel.title: The Kyiv Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: Ukraine sanctions companies, individuals aiding Russia’s weapons production, sanctions evasion
item.description: Those targeted include are citizens and residents of Russia, Hong Kong, Kyrgyzstan, and the United Arab Emirates.

item.title: Ukraine strikes Russia's Oreshnik launch site in Kapustin Yar with Flamingo missiles, General Staff says
item.description: The General Staff attributed the strikes to "using long-range strike weapons of Ukrainian production, particularly the FP-5 'Flamingo.'"

item.title: Starlink’s dangerous power | Ukraine This Week
item.description: In the latest episode of Ukraine This Week, the Kyiv Independent’s Anna Belokur examines SpaceX’s move to curb Russia’s illegal use of Starlink satellite internet — a technology that has been vital to Ukraine’s defense since 2022.

item.title: 'Situation remains difficult'– Ukraine grapples with ongoing power crisis ahead of another cold snap
item.description: Ukraine’s energy system remains under severe strain, and nuclear plants are still partially discharged as of Feb. 8 following Russia's mass attack on Ukraine's power grid overnight on Feb. 7.

item.title: Ukraine denies involvement in attempted assassination of Russian general Alekseev
item.description: “We don’t know what happened with that particular general — maybe it was their own internal Russian infighting,” Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said.

item.title: Ukraine to open 10 weapons export centers in Europe in 2026 in major wartime policy shift
item.description: Zelensky also announced the upcoming production of Ukrainian drones in Germany.

item.title: Mstyslav Chernov's film '2,000 Meters to Andriivka' wins Directors Guild of America award
item.description: Ukrainian director and journalist Mstyslav Chernov’s film "2,000 Meters to Andriivka" received the award for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Documentary at the 2026 Directors Guild of America award ceremony on Feb. 7.

item.title: 1 killed, 2 injured in Russian strikes on residential building, gas pipeline in Odesa
item.description: Russian forces carried out a series of attacks overnight on Feb. 8-9, targeting various cities with reported missile and drone attacks.

item.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,247,580 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
item.description: The number includes 1,250 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.
